Our libraries are dedicated to supporting teaching, learning, and innovation by providing access to diverse print and electronic resources, cutting-edge technologies, and expert guidance. We invite you to explore, discover, and connect with information that empowers your academic and creative journey at UniMAC. Mrs. Lydia Nyantakyi-Baah (University Librarian) Slide 2 UniMAC Library OPAC Search, discover, and access books, journals, and other library materials with ease. The UniMAC Online Catalogue connects you to our vast collection anytime, anywhere. Start your search and explore our collections. Slide 3 UniMAC Institutional Repository A digital archive dedicated to collecting, preserving, and showcasing the scholarly works, research outputs, and creative projects of the University of Media, Arts and Communication. Slide 3 Research Commons The Research & Knowledge Commons at the University of Media, Arts and Communication (UniMAC) is a dedicated research support space within the UniMAC Library designed to assist students, faculty, and researchers in their scholarly work.
